//: VJS plugin hooks. Merge this into the target repo's .claude/settings.json (cdd init does this for you). The Stop hook runs the token-light turn watchdog after every agent turn; it is inert unless .justice/ exists and ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is set, and it fails open. Set VJS_WATCHDOG_MODE=warn to make it advisory instead of blocking, or VJS_WATCHDOG=off to disable.
